name: 保存した施設に基づくおすすめの一覧
prompt:
Create one clean restaurant recommendation list section, close to the original 1080:1013 landscape-square crop. The original source crop controls the five-row geometry, thumbnail size and placement, title/metadata hierarchy, right-side save actions, spacing, and source photo crops. The Japanese preview controls the exact localized names, shared location/category text, white palette, mint save buttons, and restrained text styling.

At the top left, use the small muted-gray heading “あなたへのおすすめ”. Below it show exactly five recommendation rows, in this order. Each row has one small rounded-square food photograph at left, a dark Japanese restaurant name and a smaller gray metadata line beside it, and a bookmark outline inside a pale mint rounded-square button at the far right. Separate rows with very light gray hairlines as in the source.

1. “日本料理の食堂” — “渋谷区・食事とカフェ”
2. “地域の麺料理店” — “渋谷区・食事とカフェ”
3. “タイ料理の食堂” — “渋谷区・食事とカフェ”
4. “公園近くのカフェ” — “渋谷区・食事とカフェ”
5. “季節のレストラン” — “渋谷区・食事とカフェ”

Use the same five food photographs shown in the two references, in their original row order and close square crops: plated sushi, a bread-and-dessert table, a teapot pouring into a bowl, fruit-topped pancakes, and small savory plates on a table. Preserve each photo’s subject and composition; do not invent replacement dishes, add props, or change the crop. Keep photos small thumbnails.

Use a Japanese sans-serif similar to the preview, black restaurant titles, gray metadata and heading, compact row height, white space, muted green accent, subtle separators, and thin bookmark outline icons. Keep all five rows and labels visible, with no truncation or clipping.

Do not add the saved restaurant card, filters, tabs, app navigation, map, ratings, extra listings, extra copy, photo cards, shadows, or watermark.
reviewNotes: Five restaurant photos are visually similar but resynthesized; retain source-preserving workflow requirement.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
